integrity: All nontrivial infinite-dimensional identities are supplied analytically, and finite exact computations test cases without replacing proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact one-lag covariance for specified bilinear sawtooth, integer equal-shear family; two-lag result only for the classical map. Potential priority comparison with Crawford–Cary (1983) remains inaccessible.
title: A shear-strength autocorrelation law and exceptional first-lag cancellation for hyperbolic cat maps
